title: A Will for the Ledger
author: Emrys Underhill
blurb: Gideon Yarrow, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
